title: factory-phase result
description: The machine-readable structured output of one untrusted tester/auditor role process (FACTORY-LOOP-SPEC sections 13/16; Task 9). It is never control protocol: the trusted orchestrator validates this exact field set and derives the phase outcome from it only together with deterministic gates, the Git state, and the plan state. A blocked result must cite exact unavailable-evidence references; findings are the structured list that makes the final round non-passing under section 14 precedence.
